name: Ring (huan)
dimensions: Diameter 21 cm; Diameter 10.6 cm; Thickness 0.55 cm; Diameter 10.6 cm
summary: A flat circular slab of jade with a large central hole is referred to as a 'huan'. It was a ceremonial object in ancient times, although how it was used exactly is unknown.
